derivation:
by
  simpa [chainMass, Nat.add_assoc] using (Finset.sum_range_sub (fun n => -K (t + n)) r)
explanation: `Finset.sum_range_sub` telescopes the forward differences of a sequence. Instantiating it with `n ↦ -K (t + n)` and simplifying gives the sum of `K (t + j) - K (t + j + 1)` as `K t - K (t + r)`. The current proof instead uses induction.
